ar: الحَمْدُ لله عَلى صِلاتِهِ ثُمَّ سَلامُ اللهِ مَع صَلاتِهِ
en: All praise is due to Allah for His gifts. Then peace along with blessings of Allah...

ar: عَلَى نَبيٍ جَاءَ بِالتَوْحِيدِ وَقَدْ خَلا الدينُ عَنِ التَوْحِيدِ
en: On a Prophet who came with Divine Unity while [other] religions were empty of belief in One God.

ar: فَأْرْشَدَ الخَلْقَ لِدِيْنِ الحقِّ بِسَيْفِهِ وَهَدْيِهِ لِلْحّقِّ
en: So he guided the creation to the religion of Al-Haqq ... with his sword and his guidance to the Truth.

ar: مُحمدُ العاقِبْ لرُسْلِ رَبِّهِ وآلِهِ وصَحْبِهِ وحِزْبِهِ
en: Muhammad ﷺ, the Final of the Prophets of His Lord... and upon his kin, his companions, and his faction.

ar: وبعدُ فالعلمُ بأصلِ الدينِ مُحَتَّمٌ يَحْتَاجُ للتَّبْيِيْنِ
en: To proceed: Knowledge of the foundation of the religion is obligatory, requiring elucidation.

ar: لكنْ مِن التَّطْوِيلِ كَلَّتِ الهِمَمْ فَصَارَ فِيْهِ الاْختِصَارُ مُلَتَزَمْ
en: However, due to digressions, motivations have languished. So, summarization has grown necessary for it.

ar: وَهذِهِ أُرْجُوزَةٌ لَقبْتُها جَوْهَرَةَ التَّوْحِيْدِ قَدْ هذَّبتهُا
en: This is a versification that I have nicknamed, “The Gem of Divine Unity” which I have refined.

ar: واللهَ أرْجُو في القَبُول نَافِعاً بها مُرِيْداً في الثَّوَابِ طَامِعَاً
en: Only Allah, I ask, for acceptance, that He benefits through it the seeker hoping for reward.

ar: فَكُلُّ مَنْ كُلِّفَ شَرْعاً وَجَبَا عَلَيْه أَنْ يَعْرِفَ مَا قَدْ وَجبَا
en: Everyone who is a moral agent is legally obligated to know what is necessary...

ar: لِلهِ والجائِزَ والمُمتنِعَا ومَثلِ ذا لِرُسْلهِ فاستمِعا
en: For Allah, and what is possible and impossible. Likewise, the same for the Messengers, so listen!

ar: إذْ كُلُّ مَنْ قَلَّدَ في التَّوِحيْدِ إيمَانُهُ لمْ يَخْلُ مِنْ تَرْدِيْدِ
en: Whoever blindly imitates in Divine Unity, his belief is not safe from wavering.

ar: فَفِيْهِ بَعْضُ القَوْمِ يَحْكي الخُلْفا وبَعْضُهُمْ حَقَّقَ فِيْهِ الكَشْفَا
en: About him, some of the nation relayed a difference of opinion... and some of them asserted clarity.

ar: فَقَالَ إنْ يَجْزِمْ بقَوْلِ الغَيرِ كَفَى وَإلاَّ لَمْ يَزَلْ في الضَّيْرِ
en: He said that if he is absolutely positive based on the opinion of another... it suffices. Otherwise, he remains in grave danger.

ar: واجْزِمْ بَأَنَّ أَوَّلاً مِمَّا يَجبْ مَعْرِفَةٌ وفيْهِ خُلْفٌ مُنْتَصِبْ
en: Affirm that the first of the obligations... is knowledge, and in this is an established difference of opinion.

ar: فانْظُرْ إلى نَفْسِكَ ثُمَّ انْتَقِلِ لِلعَالَمِ العُلْوِيِّ ثمَّ السُّفْلِي
en: So reflect upon yourself, then transition... to the greater realm, then the lower.

ar: تَجِدْ بِهِ صُنْعَاً بدِيْعَ الحِكَمِ لَكِنْ بهِ قَامَ دَلِيْلُ العَدَمِ
en: Through it, you will find bewildering precision, unprecedented and meticulous. However, within it lies the proof of nonexistence.

ar: وكُلُّ ما جَازَ عَلَيْهِ العَدَمُ عَلَيهِ قَطْعَاً يَسْتَحِيْلُ القِدَمُ
en: And everything that is possible for it to be non-existent... it is absolutely impossible for it to be Beginningless.

ar: وفُسِّرَ الإيمانُ بالتصدَّيقِ والنُطقُ فيهِ الخلفُ بالتحقيقِ
en: Belief is defined as affirmation. In its utterance, the fact is there is a difference of opinion.

ar: فَقِيْلَ شَرطٌ كالعَمَلْ وقيْل بلْ شَطْرٌ والإسلامَ أَشْرِحَنَّ بالعَمَلْ
en: It is said to be a precondition, like actions. It is also said, rather it is a part of it. And Islam is explained by actions.

ar: مِثَالُ هذا الحجُّ والصَّلاةُ كذا الصيامُ فَادْرِ والزكاةُ
en: Examples of these is Hajj and prayer. Likewise, fasting and Zakat, so learn!

ar: وُرجِّحتْ زيَادةُ الإيمانِ بما تزيدُ طاعةُ الإنسانِ
en: The stronger opinion is that belief increases... with what increases the obedience of a person.

ar: فَواجِبٌ لهُ الوجودُ والقِدَمُ كَذَا بَقَاءٌ لا يُشَابُ بالعَدَمُ
en: So, necessary for Him is existence and Eternality. Likewise, Permanence that is not tarnished by non-existence.

ar: وأَنهُ لِمَا يَنالُ العَدمُ مخالفٌ، بُرهانُ هَذا القِدَمُ
en: And to anything impaired by non-existence, He is... different from it. The proof of this is Eternality.

ar: قيامُهُ بالنفسِ وَحدانيةْ مُنزَّهاً أَوصَافُهُ سَنِيَّةْ
en: And Self-Subsistence, and Oneness, free, and His Attributes lofty...

ar: عَنْ ضِدِّ أَو شِبْهٍ شَرِيْكٍ مُطْلَقَاً وَوَالِدٍ كَذَا الوَلَدْ والأصْدِقَا
en: From any opposite, peer, or partner- uncategorically... and a father, likewise a son or friends.

ar: وَقُدْرَةٌ إرَادَةٌ وَغَايَرَتْ أَمْرَاً وَعْلِمَاً والرِّضَا كما ثَبَتْ
en: And Power and Will. It is different... than a command, Knowledge, or pleasure, as is established.

ar: وَعِلْمُهُ ولا يُقالُ مُكْتَسَبْ فاتْبَعْ سَبِيِلْ الحقِّ واطْرَحِ الرِّيَبْ
en: And His Knowledge, it is not referred to as “acquired”... so follow the path of truth and cast off all doubt.

ar: حياتُهُ كَذا الْكلامُ الْسَمْعُ ثمَّ البَصَرْ، بِذي أَتانا السَمْعُ
en: His Life, likewise Speech, and Hearing... Then, Sight. These reached us through transmission.

ar: فَهلْ له إدراكٌ أوْ لا، خُلْفُ وعندَ قومٍ صحَّ فيه الوَقْفُ
en: Does He have Perception, or not? There is debate... According to a group, the correct position is suspending judgment.

ar: حَيٌ عَليمٌ قادرٌ مُريدُ سَمِعْ بَصيرٌ ما يَشَا يُريدُ
en: He is Living, All-Knowing, All-Powerful, All-Willing, All-Hearing, All-Seeing, and wills whatever He chooses.

ar: مُتْكَلِّمٌ ثُمَّ صِفَاتُ الذَاتِ لَيْسَتْ بغَيْرِ أو بِعَيْنِ الذَّاتِ
en: He is Speaking. Then, the Attributes of His Self... Are not separable from the Self, nor are they the Self itself.

ar: فقدرةٌ بُمْمكِنٍ تعلَّقَتْ بِلا تَنَاهِيْ ما بِهِ تعلَّقَتْ
en: Power is related to possibilities... there is no end to what it relates to.

ar: وَوَحْدَةً أَوْجِبْ لَها وَمْثِلُ ذيْ إرَادَةٌ والعِلْمُ لكِنْ عَمَّ ذِيْ
en: Oneness is necessary for it. Similar to it... is the Will. And Knowledge, however, it includes them [possibilities]...

ar: وعَمَّ أَيْضَاً واجِبَاً والمُمْتَنِعْ ومِثْلُ ذَا كلامُهُ فَلْنَتَّبِع
en: And it also includes necessities and impossibilities. Similar to that is His Speech- so let us follow!

ar: وكلُّ موجودٍ أنطْ للسَّمعِ بِهْ كَذَا البَصَرْ إِدْرَاكُهُ إِنْ قيلَ بِهْ
en: Relate to every existence, the Hearing of it. Likewise Sight, and Perception if it is affirmed.

ar: وَغَيْرُ عِلْمٍ هذِهِ كَمَا ثَبَتْ ثمَّ الحياةُ ما بِشَيْ تَعَلَّقَتْ
en: These are separate from Knowledge, as is [scripturally] affirmed... Then Life, and it is not related to anything.

ar: وَعِنْدَنَا أَسماؤهُ العَظِيْمَهْ كَذَا صِفَاتُ ذاتِهِ قَدِيْمهْ
en: According to us, His Exalted Names... likewise the Attributes of His Entity are eternal.

ar: واخِتْيرَ أَنَّ اسْماهُ تَوْقِيفيَّةْ كذَا الصِّفاتُ فاحفَظِ السّمعيَّةْ
en: The preferred opinion is that His Names are only transmitted... likewise the Attributes, so memorize the transmissions.

ar: وكُلُّ نصٍ أُوهَمَ التَّشْبِيها أَوِّلْهُ أَو فَوِّضْ، ورُمْ تَنْزِيها
en: Every text that instills delusion of anthropomorphism... interpret it or delegate it and intend transcendence [from bodily meaning].

ar: ونزِّه القرآنَ أيْ كلاَمهْ عنْ الحُدوْثِ واحْذَرِ انتِقامَهْ
en: And deem the Qur’an, i.e. His Speech, free... of createdness, and beware of His retribution.

ar: فكلُّ نصٍ للحدوث دلا اِحْمِلْ علىَ اللَّفْظِ الَّذي قد دلاَ
en: Every text that indicates createdness... interpret it to be the phrases that indicate [to His Speech].

ar: وَيستحِيلُ ضِدُّ ذي الصِّفاتِ في حَقّهِ كالكوْنِ في الجِهاتِ
en: The opposite of these attributes are impossible... in His right, such as being in a direction.

ar: وجائزٌ في حقه ما أمكنا إيجاداً اعْداماً كرزقه الغنى
en: It is possible in His right what is possible... creating or annihilation, such as His giving wealth.

ar: فَخَالِقٌ لِعَبْدِهِ وَمَا عَمِلْ مُوَفِّقٌ لِمَنْ أَرَادَ أنْ يَصِلْ
en: So, He is the Creator of His slaves and what they do... and the Enabler of success to whomever He wills to attain it.

ar: وَخَاذِلٌ لِمَنْ أرَادَ بُعْدَهُ وَمُنْجِزٌ لِمَنْ أَرادَ وَعْدَهُ
en: And forsakes whoever He wills to be distanced from it... And fulfills His Promise for whomever He wishes.

ar: فوزُ السَّعيْدِ عنْدَهُ في الأزَلِ كَذا الشَّقِيُّ ثُمّ لمْ يَنَتَقِلِ
en: The felicity of the successful is ordained with Him Pre-Eternally... Likewise misery, then it does not transfer.

ar: وَعِنْدَنَا لِلْعَبْدِ كَسْبٌ كُلِّفَا وَلمْ يَكُنْ مُؤَثِّراً فَلْتَعْرِفا
en: According to us, the acquisition (kasb) of the slave makes him morally responsible... but it has no causal effect, so take note!

ar: فَلَيْسَ مَجْبوراً ولا اخْتِيَاراً وَلَيْسَ كُلّاً يَفْعَلُ اختِيارَا
en: So, he is not compelled and without free will... Nor does he do everything freely.

ar: فإنْ يُثِبْنَا فَبِمَحْضِ الفَضْلِ وإنْ يُعذِّبْ فَبِمَحْضِ العَدْلِ
en: So if He rewards us, it is completely by [His] grace... And if He punishes us, it is completely by [His] justice.

ar: وَقَولُهُمْ إنَّ الصَّلاحَ واجِبُ عليه زُورٌ مَا عَلَيْهِ واجِبُ
en: And their saying that providential care is necessary upon Him... is false testimony of what is necessary for Him.

ar: أَلَمْ يَرَوْا إيلاَمهُ الأطْفالا وَشِبْهَها فَحاذِرِ المحالا
en: Do they not see His causing of pain for children... and the likes? So, beware of retribution!

ar: وجَائزٌ عَليْه خَلْقُ الشَّرِّ والخيْرِ كالإسلامِ وجَهْلِ الكُفرِ
en: It is possible for him to create evil... And good, such as Islam and the ignorance of disbelief.

ar: وَوَاجِبٌ إيمانُنَا بالقَدَرِ وَبالقَضَا كَمَا أَتَى في الخَبَرِ
en: Our belief in Predestination is obligatory... and the Decree, as it has come in the transmission.

ar: وَمِنْهُ أنْ يُنْظَرَ بالأبْصَارِ لكِنْ بِلاَ كَيْفٍ ولا انْحِصَارِ
en: And of it is that He will be seen by [believers’] sights... however, without modality or totality.

ar: لِلْمْؤِمنينَ إذْ بِجائِزْ عُلِّقَتْ هذا ولِلْمُخْتَارِ دُنْيَا ثَبتتْ
en: For the believers, because it was connected to rational possibility... And for the Chosen One, it was affirmed in this life.

ar: وَمِنْهُ إرْسَالُ جَمِيْعِ الرُّسْلِ فَلاَ وُجُوبَ بَلْ بِمَحْضِ الفَضْلِ
en: And of it is the sending of all the Messengers... It is not necessary; rather it is completely from [His] grace.

ar: لَكِنْ بذا إيْمانُنَا قَدْ وَجَبا فَدَعْ هَوَى قَوْمٍ بِهِمْ قدْ لَعِبَا
en: However, it is obligatory for us to believe in this... So abandon the whims of the people who jest with them.

ar: وَواجِبٌ في حَقِّهِمْ الَامانهْ وَصِدْقُهُمْ وَضِفْ لَهُ الفَطَانَه
en: It is necessary in their right to have integrity... and their truthfulness, and add to it intelligence.

ar: وَمِثْلُ ذا تَبْلِيْغُهُمِ لما أَتَوا وَيَسْتَحِيْلُ ضِدُّها كَما رَوَوْا
en: Similar to that is their conveyance of what they came with... and impossible is their opposites, as is relayed.

ar: وَجَائِزٌ في حَقّهِمْ كالأكلِ وكَالجِماعِ للِنِّسا في الحِلِّ
en: It is possible in their right, things like eating... and like sexual intercourse with women in the state of permissibility.

ar: وجَامِعٌ مَعْنى الَّذِي تَقَرَّرَا شَهادتا الإسْلامِ فاطْرَحِ المِرا
en: The summary of the meanings that are stipulated... is the two testimonies of Islam, so leave any argumentation!

ar: وَلَمْ تَكُنْ نُبُوَّةٌ مُكْتَسَبَةْْ وَلَوْ رَقَى في الخْيرِ أَعْلَى عَقَبَةْْ
en: Prophethood is never acquired... even if he were to ascend in good up to the loftiest of summits.

ar: بَلْ ذَاكَ فَضْلُ اللهِ يؤتيهِ لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ جَلَّ اللهُ واهِبُ المِنَنْ
en: Rather, it is the grace of Allah that He gives to whoever... He wishes, Glory to Allah, the Bestower of gifts.

ar: وَأَفْضَلُ الخَلْقِ عَلَى الإطْلاقِ نَبِيّنَا فَمِلْ عَنِ الشقَاقِ
en: The greatest creation, without restriction... is our Prophet, so steer away from deviation.

ar: والأَنِبِيَا يَلْونَهُ في الفَضْلِ وَبَعْدَهُمْ ملائِكَهْ ذٍّي الفَضْلِ
en: The Prophets follow him in rank... and after them is the Angels [of Allah], to whom all grace belongs.

ar: هذا وَقَوْمٌ فَصَّلُوا إذ فَضّلُوا وَبَعْضُ كُلٍّ بَعْضَهُ قَدْ يَفْضُلُ
en: [Know this], and a group differentiated when ranking... And some of them are indeed higher in rank than others.

ar: بالمُعْجِزَاتِ أُيِّدُوا تَكَرّمَا وَعِصْمَةَ الْبَارِيِ لكُلٍّ حَتِّما
en: With miracles, they were corroborated, as a gift... and infallibility from the Creator for all of them is necessary.

ar: وخُصَّ خيرُ الخلق أنْ قد تمما بِهِ الجميعَ ربُّنا وعمَّما
en: The greatest of creation was distinguished in that Our Lord completed... through him all of them. And He made universal-

ar: بِعثَتَهُ فشرعُهُ لا يُنْسَخُ بغيره حتى الزمانُ يُنْسَخُ
en: -his mission, so his Law will never be abrogated... by other than it until the end of time.

ar: وَنَسْخُهُ لِشَرْعِ غَيْرِهِ وَقَعْ حَتْماً أَذلَّ اللهُ مَنْ لَهُ مَنَعْ
en: And its abrogation of all other laws occurred... necessarily. May Allah humiliate those who deny it!

ar: ونسخُ بعضِ شرعِهِ بالبعض أجزْ وما في ذا له من غَضِّ
en: The abrogation of part of his Law with another part... is rationally possible. And there is nothing from this that is a deficiency.

ar: ومعجزاتُه كثيرةٌ غُرَرْ منها كلامُ اللهِ معجزُ البشرْ
en: His miracles are numerous, well-known... of them is the Word of Allah, incapacitated mankind.

ar: واجزِمْ بمعراجِ النبيْ كما رَوَوا وبرِّئَنْ لعائشهْ مما رَمَوا
en: And affirm the ascension of the Prophet ﷺ as it is transmitted... and vindicate Aisha رضي الله عنها from what they accused.

ar: وصَحْبُهُ خيرُ القُرونِ فاستمعْ فَتَابِعِيْ فتابعٌ لِمَنْ تبعْ
en: His companions are the greatest generation, so listen!... then their followers, then the followers of their followers.

ar: وخيرُهم من وُلِّيَ الخِلافَة وأمرُهُم في الفَضْلِ كالخِلافَة
en: The best of them are those entrusted with the Caliphate... and the affair of their rank is like the order of the Caliphate.

ar: يَليهمُ قَومٌ كِرامٌ بَرَرَةْ عِدَّتُهُم سِتٌ تمامُ العَشَرة
en: Following them is the group of noble and righteous men... their number is six, completing the Ten.

ar: فأهلُ بَدْرٍ العظيمِ الشَّانِ فأهلُ احُدْ فَبَيْعَةُ الرِّضْوانِ
en: Then, the people of Badr, of immense significance... then the people of Uhud, then the Covenant of Ridwan.

ar: والسابقون فَضلُهُم نصاً عُرِفْ هذا وفي تعيينهم قدِ اختُلِفْ
en: The rank of the Forerunners is known by textual proof... [Know] this, and there is a difference of opinion in their identification.

ar: وأوِّلِ التَّشَاجُرَ الذي وَرَدْ إنْ خُضْتَ فيه واجْتَنِبْ داءَ الحَسَدْ
en: And interpret the dispute that is mentioned... if you must delve into it. And refrain from slandering them.

ar: ومالكٌ وسَائرُ الأئِمَّة كذا أبو القاسمْ هُداةُ الأمَّة
en: And Malik, and the rest of the Imams... likewise Abu Al-Qasim [Al-Junayd Al-Salik] are the guides of the Nation.

ar: فواجبٌ تَقليدُ حَبْرٍ مِنهُمُ كَذَا حَكَى القَوْمُ بِلَفْظٍ يُفْهَمُ
en: It is obligatory to follow the authoritative scholar from them... this has been relayed by the people with clear statements.

ar: وَأَثْبِتَنْ للأَوْلِيَا الكَرَامَة وَمَنْ نَفَاها فَانْبِذَنْ كلامَهْ
en: And affirm for the Saints miraculous gifts... And whoever denies them, cast aside his speech.

ar: وَعِنْدَنا أن الدُّعاءَ يَنْفَعُ كما مِنَ القُرْآنِ وَعْدَاً يُسْمَعُ
en: According to us, supplication benefits... as it is heard promised in the Qur’an.

ar: بكلِّ عَبْدٍ حافظونَ وُكِّلُوا وكاتِبونَ خِيْرَةٌ لَنْ يُهْمِلوا
en: Entrusted for every slave are guardians... and selected writers that are never remiss-

ar: مِنْ أَمْرِهِ شَيْئَاً فَعَلْ ولو ذَهِلْ حتى الأنِينَ في المرَضْ كما نُقِلْ
en: -in any of his matters that he did, even absent-mindedly... even the moans during sickness, as is transmitted.

ar: فَحَاسِبِ النفْسَ وَقَلِّلْ الَاأمَلا فرُبَّ مَنْ جَدَّ لأمْرٍ وَصَلا
en: So hold the ego accountable, and reduce [your] desires... For often does the one who strives attain [his goal].

ar: وَوَاجِبٌ إيمانُنَا بالموتِ ويَقْبِضُ الرُّوْحَ رَسُولُ الموتِ
en: Our belief in death is obligatory... and the Angel of Death collects the soul.

ar: ومَيِّتٌ بِعُمْرِهِ مَنْ يُقْتَلُ وغيرُ هذا باطلٌ لا يُقْبَلُ
en: The one killed has died at his [predestined] age... other than that is falsehood that is not accepted.

ar: وفي فَنَا النَّفْسِ لَدَى النَّفْخِ اخْتُلِفْ واستظْهَرَ السُّبكي بقاها الَّذْ عُرفْ
en: And the annihilation of the soul during the blowing [of the Horn] is differed upon... and [Taqi ul-Din] Al-Subki selected its remaining, which was known.

ar: عَجْبُ الذَّنَبْ كالرُّوحِ لكنْ صَحَّحَا المُزَنيُّ لِلْبِلَى وَوَضَّحا
en: The tailbone is like the soul, however Al-Muzani selected... its annihilation and elucidated it.

ar: وكُلُّ شَيءٍ هالكٌ قدْ خَصَّصوا عُمُومَهُ فاطلب لما قَدْ لخَّصُّوا
en: And they specified the generality of “everything is bound to perish” [Al-Qasas, 88]... so seek out what they summarized!

ar: ولا تَخُضْ في الروحِ إذْ ما وَرَدَا نَصٌّ مِنَ الشارِعِ لَكِنْ وُجِدَا
en: And do not delve into the soul, since there is no text relayed...from the Lawgiver, however there exists...

ar: لمالكٍ هِيَ صُورَةٌ كالجسدِ فَحَسْبُك النصُّ بهذا السَّنَدِ
en: ... from Malik a statement that it is a shape like the body... so the statement should suffice you with this chain of narration.

ar: والعقْلُ كالرُّوحِ وَلكنْ قَرَّرُوا فيهِ خِلافاً فانْظُرَنْ ما فَسَّرُوا
en: The intellect is like the soul, but they agreed... that there is a difference of opinion. So look towards what they explained.

ar: سُؤَالُنا ثَّم عَذَابُ القَبرِ نَعِيْمُهُ واجِبْ كَبَعْثِ الحشرِ
en: Our questioning, then the punishment of the grave... and its reward is obligatory [to affirm]. Likewise, the Resurrection and Gathering.

ar: وَقُلْ يُعَادُ الجُسمُ بالتحقيقِ عَنْ عَدَمٍ وَقِيلَ عَن تفريقِ
en: And say that the body will return in its essence... after non-existence, and it is said after separation...

ar: مَحْضَين لكنْ ذا الخلافُ خُصَّا بالأنبيا ومن عليهم نُصَّا
en: ... both completely, however this difference of opinion is specific... due to the Prophets and the ones about whom a text exists.

ar: وفي إعادةِ العَرَضْ قولانِ ورُجِّحَتْ إعادةُ الأعيانِ
en: And in [the possibility] of returning of accidentals, there are two opinions... and the preponderant opinion is the return of them exactly.

ar: وفي الزَّمَنْ قولانِ والحِسَابُ حَقٌّ، وما في حقٍّ ارْتِيَابُ
en: And about time, there are two opinions. And the Account... is true. And there is no doubt in its veracity.

ar: فالسيئاتُ عِنْدَهُ بالمثلِ والحسناتُ ضُوْعِفَتْ بالفَضْلِ
en: And sins with Him are by their like... and good deeds are multiplied by [His] generosity.

ar: وَباجْتِنَابٍ لِلْكبَائرْ تُغْفَرُ صَغَائِرٌ وَجَا الوُضُو يُكَفِّرُ
en: And by refraining from the major sins, forgiven... are the minor deeds. And it is transmitted that Wudu’ expiates.

ar: واليومُ الآخِرْ ثمَّ هَوْلُ الموقِفِ حَقٌّ فَخَفِّفْ يا رحيمٌ واسْعِفِ
en: And the Last Day, then the horror of the standing point... are true. So alleviate [it for us], Oh Merciful, and grant aid!

ar: وواجبٌ أَخْذُ العِبَادِ الصُّحُفَا كما مِنَ القُرآن نَصًَا عُرِفَا
en: And obligatory [to believe] is the slaves taking their books... as is known from the text of the Qur’an.

ar: وَمِثْلُ هَذا الوَزْنُ والميزانُ فَتُوْزَنُ الكُتْبُ أوِ الأعْيانُ
en: Like this is the Weighing and the Scales... the books or [the actions] themselves.

ar: كذا الصِّراطُ، فالعِبَادُ مُخْتلِفْ مُرورُهُمْ، فسالمٌ وَمُنْتَلِفْ
en: Likewise, the Path, and the slaves differ... in their crossing. Some are safe, and some doomed.

ar: والعَرْشُ والكُرْسيُّ ثَّم القَلَمُ والكاتبونَ اللوحُ كُلٌّ حِكَمُ
en: And the Throne and the Seat, then the Pen... the Writers, and The Tablet- all have a wisdom.

ar: لا لاحتياجٍ وبها الإيمانُ يجبْ عَلَيكَ أيَّها الإنْسَانُ
en: Not due to dependence, and of them our belief... is obligatory, oh mankind!

ar: والنارُ حقٌّ أُوجدَتْ كالجنَّة فلا تَمِلْ لجاحدٍ ذي جِنَّة
en: The Fire is true, and exists now like Paradise... so do not side with its deluded rejectors.

ar: دارَا خُلُودٍ للسَّعيدِ والشَّقِيْ مُعَذَّبٌ مُنَعَّمٌ مَهْمَا بَقِيْ
en: A permanent abode for the felicitous and the miserable... either punished or rewarded wherever they reside.

ar: إيمانُنَا بحوضِ خَيرِ الرُّسْلِ حَتْمٌ كَمَا قَدْ جَاءَنَا في النَّقلِ
en: Our belief in the Pool of the Greatest Messenger... is obligatory as has reached us in by transmission.

ar: يَنَالُ شُرْباً منهُ أقوامٌ وَفَوا بعهدهِم وَقُلْ يُذَادُ مَنْ طَغَوا
en: From it drinks nations who fulfilled... their Covenant. And say that the ones who overstepped shall be casted away.

ar: وَوَاجِبٌ شَفَاعَةُ المُشفَّعِ محمدٌ مقدَّماً لا تَمْنَعِ
en: And obligatory is the intercession of the Intercessor... Muhammad, who precedes. And do not deny it!

ar: وغيْرُهُ من مُرْتَضَى الأخْيَارِ يَشْفَعْ كما قَدْ جاءَ في الأخْبارِ
en: And other than him, whom He is pleased with, selected... intercede as has reached us in the reports.

ar: ذْ جَائز غُفْرانُ غيِر الكُفْرِ فلا نُكَفِّرْ مؤمناً بالوِزْرِ
en: Because forgiveness for other than disbelief is possible... so we do not deem a believer a disbeliever due to sin.

ar: وَمَنْ يَمُتْ ولم يَتُبْ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ فأمرُهُ مُفَوَّضٌ لِرَبِّهِ
en: Whoever dies and does not repent from his sins... then his affair is delegated with his Lord.

ar: وَوَاجِبٌ تَعْذِيبُ بَعْضٍ ارْتَكَبْ كبيرةً ثم الخلودُ مُجْتَنَبْ
en: It is obligatory [to believe in] the punishment of some of those absorbed in... major sins. Then [believing that] their permanent residency in it will not occur.

ar: وَصِفْ شَهِيْدَ الحرْبِ بالحياةِ وَرِزْقُهُ مِنْ مُشْتَهى الجنَّاتِ
en: And attribute the martyr in battle with life... and his sustenance with the desirable objects of the Gardens.

ar: فيرزُقُ الله الحلالَ فاعْلَمَا ويرزُقُ المكرُوْهَ والمحرَّما
en: So know that Allah provides with permissible things... and what is disliked, and what is impermissible.

ar: في الاكتِسابِ والتوَّكلِّ اخْتُلِفْ والراجحُ التفصيلُ حَسْبَما عُرِفْ
en: And in seeking means, or putting one’s trust [in Allah], there is a difference of opinion... and the preponderant is that it depends, based on what is known [from the books].

ar: وعندَنا الشيءُ هوَ الموجودُ وثابتٌ في الخارجِ الموجودُ
en: According to us, a thing is what exists... and what exists is what remains in the real world.

ar: وجودُ شَيءٍ عينُهُ والجَوهَرُ الفردُ حادثْ عندنا لا يُنْكَرُ
en: The existence of something is that very thing, and the indivisible particle... is created and is not denied according to us.

ar: ثم الذُّنُوبُ عندَنَا قِسْمَانِ صغيرةٌ كبيرةٌ فالثاني
en: Then, according to us, sins are of two types... minor and major. So the second...

ar: منه المتابُ واجبٌ في الحالِ ولا انتقاضٌ إنْ يعدْ للحالِ
en: Repentance from it is obligatory immediately... and it is not negated even if he immediately returns to it.

ar: لَكِنْ يجدِّدْ توبةً لما اقترفْ وفي القَبُولِ رأيهُمْ قَدِ اخْتَلَفْ
en: However, he must renew his repentance for what he committed... and in acceptance, their opinions differed.

ar: وَحِفْظُ دِيْنٍ ثمَّ نفسٍ مال نسبْ ومثلُهَا عقلٌ وعرضٌ قدْ وجبْ
en: Preservation of religion, self, wealth, lineage... and like them is the intellect and honor is indeed obligatory.

ar: وَمَنْ لمعلومٍ ضرورةً جَحَدْ مِنْ ديننا يُقْتَلُ كُفْراً ليسَ حدْ
en: And whoever rejects what is known by necessity... from our religion is killed as a disbeliever, not as a hadd punishment.

ar: ومثلُ هذا مَنْ نَفَى لِمُجْمعِ أو استباحَ كالزنا فلتَسْمَعِ
en: Like that is the one who rejects what there is consensus upon... or makes permissible something like fornication, so listen!

ar: وواجبٌ نَصْبِ إمامِ عدلِ بالشرعِ فاعلمْ لا بحكمِ العقلِ
en: It is obligatory to establish an upright leader... by the transmitted sources, so know it is not a rational judgment.

ar: فليسَ رُكْناً يُعْتَقَدْ في الدينِ ولا تزغْ عنْ أمرِهِ المبينِ
en: He is not a pillar who must be believed in in the religion... And do not go against his clear command.

ar: إِلا بِكُفْرٍ فانْبِذَنَّ عهدَهُ فالله يَكْفينا أذاهُ وَحْدَهُ
en: Except in disbelief, then secede from his allegiance... For Allah alone will suffice us from his harm.

ar: بغيرِ هذا لا يباحُ صَرْفُهُ وليسَ يعزلَ انْ أزيلَ وصفُهُ
en: For other than this, it is not permissible to abandon him... He is not discharged if one of his attributes are lacking.

ar: وَأْمُرْ بعرفٍ واجتنبْ نميمةْ وغيبةً وخصلةً ذميمةْ
en: And command what is right, and stay away from slander... and backbiting, and every blameworthy characteristic.

ar: كالعُجْبِ والكِبْرِ وداءِ الحَسَدِ وكالمراءِ والجدلْ فاعتمدِ
en: Such as self-conceit, arrogance, the disease of envy... like argumentation and polemics, so rely!

ar: وكُنْ كَمَا كانَ خيارُ الخلقِ حليفَ حِلْمٍ تابعاً للحقِّ
en: And be how the Chosen of Creation were... always forbearing, following the truth.

ar: فكلِّ خيرٍ في اتباعِ من سلفْ وكلُّ شَرٍّ في ابتداعِ مَنْ خَلَفْ
en: Every good comes from following the Predecessors... and every evil from innovation of those who came later.

ar: وكلُّ هديٍ للنبيِّ قدْ رَجَحْ فما أبيحَ افْعَلْ وَدَعْ ما لم يُبَحْ
en: Every path of the Prophet ﷺ is indeed preponderent... so do what he permitted, and leave what he forbade.

ar: فتابعِ الصالَح ممنْ سَلَفا وجانِبِ البدعةَ ممن خَلَفا
en: So follow the righteous ones from the predecessors... and avoid the innovation of those who came after.

ar: هذا وأرجو الله في الإخلاصِ من الرياءِ ثم في الخلاصِ
en: Know this, and I ask Allah for sincerity... from showing off, then in being free...

ar: من الرجيمِ ثم نفسي والهوى فمنْ يَمِلْ لهؤلاء قدْ غوى
en: ...from the accursed one, then my ego, and whims... For whoever follows whims has indeed gone astray.

ar: هذا وأرجو الله أن يمنَحَنَا عندَ السؤالِ مُطْلَقاً حُجَّتَنا
en: This, I ask Allah that He confer us... during all of our questioning with what we require.

ar: ثم الصلاةُ والسلامُ الدائمُ على نبيٍّ دأبُهُ المراحمُ
en: Then blessings and peace, endlessly... on the Prophet ﷺ, the persistently merciful...

ar: محمدٍ وصحبه وعِتْرَتِهْ وتابعٍ لنهجه من أُمَّتِهْ
en: ... Muhammad, his companions, and his family... and the followers of his way from his nation.
